failed_or_abandoned: First script run: output log not captured because tee opened before the script created output/work/P043 (script results unaffected; rerun with mkdir).
Treating W as an independent nuisance on the NR energy scale rejected as double counting with the Nq-scale (the contour scale is fixed by S1c crossings, not by W).

Full nestpy GetQuanta MC per nuisance draw judged unnecessary: the 2D Gaussian proxy reproduces P009's E_ML to 0.5 keV and P024's band shifts to 0.01 sigma; the band baseline is anchored to P024's MC (offset -0.052 sigma).
The posterior-averaged mean of 1/eps is dominated by a heavy tail (skew 57); median and 68% interval quoted instead.
Symbolic derivatives through nestpy not attempted; uncertainties.wrap numerical derivatives agree with the analytic elasticity to 1%.
